_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Population extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Population the CONDITION-CODES (fertility_decline, migration_surge...) never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger; this table bridges them. As in Finance, Population activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so active diagnosis ids already self-match; the condition-code map is the part that is strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(population-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L136-165)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L174-180 / L46-92)--> diagnosis id --(population.json issues[]; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis indicator but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from population.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29 pattern).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: (1) Finance inlines classification over a distinct condition vocabulary whose codes ARE the contract indicator tokens; Population is the SAME shape (its condition-codes fertility_decline/aging_skew... ARE the primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation tokens). (2) Both have activation.diagnosticTriggers = DIAGNOSIS IDs (self-matching). (3) HETEROGENEITY: dependency_ratio is a SHARED primaryIndicator of TWO diagnoses (POPULATION_COLLAPSE and AGING_CRISIS) and its classify branch emits BOTH families -> it folds into both. This cross-diagnosis fold has no Finance analog. (4) HETEROGENEITY: healthcare_overload is listed as a PRIMARY indicator of PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK, but the classify switch routes healthcare_overload ONLY to aging/healthcare families (it is absent from the pandemic classify branch, L159), so it can NEVER satisfy PANDEMIC's requiredFamily gate. It folds into AGING_CRISIS only; PANDEMIC is listed as a NON-folded indicator. A primaryIndicator token that structurally cannot trigger its own diagnosis = a genuine wiring gap. (5) ORPHAN COUNT: Finance 3, Population 0 -- Population's four unreachable activations (UNC/EI/PULV/STN) all have EMPTY diagnosticTriggers, so they are extinction-exempt, not orphans. (6) Population stress catch-all uses NAMED tokens (population_high_stress/structural_stress) that DO emit a family (structural_event) but no contract consumes it -- vs Finance _stress_* which emitted no family at all.
